method: Compare exact Georgian spellings with all dictionary and vocabulary review JSON files, including skipped and rejected batches. Individually inspect the intended noun/adjective sense in language or educational sources.
limitations: Owner review complete: 14 approved and six rejected. No boards generated or repetition change measured. No active dictionary, policy, pack or save changes.
sourceAttribution: Georgian explanatory dictionary/Linguistic Technologies Group; Dictionary.ge; University of Georgia synonym dictionary; NPLG dictionaries; ena.ge educational vocabulary; techdict.ge. Brief adapted English glosses; source links and available page hashes retained.
